svg.title: Order entry (1 clerk) — A noticeable difference in its one test
svg.desc: Order entry (1 clerk): A noticeable difference in its one test. Median per test for SQL Server, MySQL and PostgreSQL, each on its own scale from zero; coloured bars mark differences a user would notice, grey bars ties and differences too small to notice. Enter sales orders – 1 clerk: MySQL and PostgreSQL noticeably slower than SQL Server. Per order saved: MySQL 145 ms more (20% slower) and PostgreSQL 108 ms more (15% slower).
